interpretation: Agreement with external software on diagnostic examples, not game accuracy. Corpus disagreements have no truth label.

oldRoundingSensitivity.weighting: Record-height rows; duplicate settings are retained. This is not an independent sample count.

crossTool.scope: Equal old/new/authored height. Clean-room restatements of published formulas; no third-party code. All tools share length = roundEven(size*H/480), thickness = max(1, roundEven(thickness*H/480)) in double precision, gap = trunc(4 + gap) + origin(thickness), native clamps 0..255 / 1..32 / 0..128; only origin differs. Software agreement only, never game evidence. Outlier = ours differs from every tool.

shareCodeGrid.design: size 0..3, thickness 0..3, gap -8..4 in share-code 0.1 steps; heights 720/960/1080/1440/2160; synthetic

boundaryGrid.design: Seed 2026100202, 20000 synthetic rows: ordinary, binary32 half-pixel size/thickness, integer-gap +-1e-7 and large (size 80-140, thickness 12-20, gap 60-140) strata

gapOriginSensitivity.scope: Equal heights. Alternative = our exported gap minus (thickness % 2), clamped to 0: the floor(W/2) odd-width origin. clampedAtZeroRows have an odd width and gap 0, so the cvar cannot move although the intended geometry would.

outlineEvaluation.scope: Research only; the solver objective and compareMasks stay core-only. Old outline = legacyOutlineExtent (source rule); new outline = nativeOutlineExtent (assumed, unverified). ruleOnly draws both extents around the same old core. Aligned metrics move the whole new crosshair by the <=1 px shift that best matches the old core.
